violations.why: Timer_C (prio 4) can preempt Timer_A between its read and write of timerCount, so the increment is lost.
Timer_C can preempt Timer_A after its write and reset timerCount, so the check at line 95 reads a different value.
Timer_C can write timerCount between Timer_A's read at line 93 and its read at line 95, so the two reads disagree.
Timer_A (prio 3) can preempt Timer_B between its write and its check and change timerCount.
Timer_C can preempt Timer_B between its write and its check and overwrite timerCount.
Timer_Force (prio 3) can preempt Timer_B between its write and its check and set timerCount to 1.
